subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram polling self-conflicts on macOS 2026.4.29 even with a single local gateway process

question: Should Telegram polling recovery make poll ownership and awaited cancellation the primary invariant, or preserve the current timeout/rebuild model and add only bounded 409 retry spacing?
rationale: Both approaches change restart and failure-recovery timing; live evidence shows the current mitigations are insufficient, but source-only review cannot safely choose the permanent lifecycle contract.

options.title: Single-owner lifecycle
options.body: Make one session own each token, await cancellation and server-side release before replacement, and use 409 retry only as secondary recovery.

options.title: Retry-spacing mitigation
options.body: Keep the existing rebuild ownership model but add a measured inter-poll or post-409 delay sufficient to avoid Telegram's stale-poll window.

options.title: Require live isolation proof first
options.body: Defer code changes until a maintainer reproduces the current-main conflict and identifies whether classic, isolated, or restart-boundary ownership overlaps.

recommendation.title: Single-owner lifecycle
recommendation.body: Make one session own each token, await cancellation and server-side release before replacement, and use 409 retry only as secondary recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns isolated-ingress 409 classification and recovery, the closest current boundary for deciding the permanent lifecycle contract.
